title: diag.3: radio — consecutive EBUSY counter
description: In lora_l2_tx.c, count consecutive -EBUSY returns from lora_send. After 3 in a row, report DIAG_RADIO_MODEM_HELD. After 10, report DIAG_RADIO_TX_DEAD. Detects the modem-hold race (aglf) on real hardware where RX async holds the modem.
close_reason: Consecutive-EBUSY detector landed in lichen/subsys/lichen/l2/lora_l2_tx.c per the bead: a Kconfig-gated (CONFIG_LICHEN_DIAG) counter tracks consecutive -EBUSY returns from lora_send; at 3 in a row it reports LICHEN_DIAG_RADIO_MODEM_HELD, at 10 it reports LICHEN_DIAG_RADIO_TX_DEAD, via lichen_diag_report(LICHEN_DIAG_SUB_RADIO, ...) into the ring from ldzz.1. Any success or non-EBUSY error resets the streak; duty-cycle/mutex/CSMA -EBUSY paths return before lora_send so cannot touch the counter (reviewer-verified). Message literals shortened to fit the 33-char diag field (reviewer P3). Companion fixes in this commit: lichen_diag_init wired via SYS_INIT(APPLICATION) — reviewer P1 found s_initialized never set (zero callers), making ALL diag reports inert; that defect would have silently disabled every ldzz detector. Verification: cppcheck gate exit 0 on diag dir + lora_l2_tx.c. Codereview: 1 full Kimi K3 pass — 4 claims all PASS (reset semantics, mutex-serialized counter access, streak scope excludes duty/mutex EBUSY paths, event codes match diag.h), findings 1 (P1 inert init) fixed via SYS_INIT wiring, findings 2-3 message length fixed; follow-up beads filed: worker6-euhf (diag ring unsynchronized reader — pre-existing, low), worker6-ldzz.2/.4-.11 remain for the detector family.
